assets.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create a finished horizontal premium fantasy collectible card game logo. Exact primary text: "KALISTAR". Exact small subtitle: "CARD GAME". SPELL K A L I S T A R correctly. Custom sculpted serif lettering, luminous pearl-silver faces with restrained rose-copper engraved bevels; one distinctive prismatic diamond crystal nestled above the central letters, geometric angular metal setting echoing the copper frames in this card reference. Small angular side flourishes, refined heraldic craft like the tactile vibrant faction banners. Readable silhouette at 220px wide. No circular badge, no enclosing rectangle, no shield outline, no huge background illustration, no additional words. Wide 3:1 image, centred logo occupies 85% width and 75% height. Pure uniform BLACK #000000 background for clean screen blending. NO checkerboard, no atmospheric fog, no glow blobs. Jewel can have restrained teal, ruby and pale gold facets, lettering remains silver. Reference card is visual material vocabulary, not an edit target: do not include robot or card UI.

Use case: stylized-concept. Kalistar card game playable battlefield background, one finished high resolution landscape 16:9 digital oil-painted environment. A perfectly readable top-down slightly oblique view of an ancient dark grey STONE duelling table in a roofless ruined observatory. Broad EMPTY graphite grey central stone plane takes up 80% of the image, subtle worn engraved angular copper inlays and cracks, no drawn card slots, no UI, no writing, no characters. At far left edge a small emerald crystalline overgrowth; far right a compact ruby crystal and weathered carved pillar. At top and bottom edge sculpted silver-copper metal rails matching handmade fantasy card frames. One quiet engraved prismatic diamond at true centre, low contrast so cards and controls can be overlaid. Museum-like raking natural daylight makes actual stone visible. Restrained charcoal, forest green, pale silver, a few coral-copper highlights; NOT a blue/purple or brown/gold-dominated image. Painterly beautiful tactile game board, softly uneven stone grain, no bokeh, no floating orbs, no fog, no gradients, no empty black backdrop. Full bleed, no decorative outer rectangular preview frame.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create the reverse side artwork of a Kalistar collectible card. Portrait aspect 3:5, full bleed image of one card BACK, not a mockup, no perspective tilt, no hand. Precise mirror-symmetric design. Deep charcoal textured enamel centre, restrained rose-copper and silver double frame with elegant angular corners, central large faceted prismatic diamond in an angular metal setting, narrow emerald and ruby inlay filigree. Use the provided Kalistar logo as brand design reference for crystal, type and metal material. Exact small centred word "KALISTAR" under the central diamond, no other text, no numbers. Fine engravings and premium tactile hand-painted finish. Elegant and readable, not too crowded. No blue-purple overall palette, no brown backdrop, no canvas outside the card, no drop shadow around whole asset. The card itself fills the canvas. No checkerboard.
